subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does the reporter have a concrete private reproduction showing an ACP action executing or being forwarded before its permission request resolves?
rationale: The issue alleges a serious authorization bypass but lacks the evidence needed to distinguish a real boundary violation from confusion between independent token, stream, and permission paths; exploit details should not be developed publicly.

options.title: Route to private security triage
options.body: Ask the reporter to submit the exact payload, timing sequence, configuration, version, and observed unauthorized action through a private GitHub Security Advisory, then hide or close the public report as appropriate.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Close the report if private follow-up cannot demonstrate an action crossing the approval boundary and the alleged tokenization path cannot be identified in current source.
